title: AP® Calculus AB
subject: Mathematics
alignment: AP® Calculus AB exam (unit order follows the usual course sequence; outline written in our own words)

units.title: Limits and continuity
objectives: Estimate limits from graphs and tables, and find them with algebra
Use the squeeze theorem and limits at infinity to describe function behavior
Decide whether a function is continuous and apply the intermediate value theorem

units.title: What a derivative is
objectives: Interpret the derivative as a rate of change and as the slope of a tangent line
Find derivatives from the limit definition
Apply the power, product, quotient and trigonometric derivative rules

units.title: Chain rule, implicit and inverse derivatives
objectives: Differentiate compositions with the chain rule
Use implicit differentiation to find slopes on curves
Differentiate inverse functions, including inverse trigonometric functions, and find higher-order derivatives

units.title: Derivatives in context
objectives: Interpret derivatives in applied settings, including position, velocity and acceleration
Solve related rates problems
Approximate values with local linearization and evaluate limits with L'Hôpital's rule

units.title: Analyzing functions with derivatives
objectives: Apply the mean value theorem and the extreme value theorem
Use the first and second derivatives to find extrema, intervals of increase and concavity
Sketch and connect the graphs of a function and its derivatives
Solve optimization problems

units.title: Integrals and the Fundamental Theorem
objectives: Approximate accumulated change with Riemann and trapezoidal sums
Use the Fundamental Theorem of Calculus to connect derivatives and integrals
Find antiderivatives with basic rules and substitution, and evaluate definite integrals

units.title: Differential equations
objectives: Verify solutions to differential equations and sketch slope fields
Solve separable differential equations with initial conditions
Model exponential growth and decay with differential equations

units.title: Applications of integration
objectives: Find the average value of a function and net change from a rate
Use integrals to find displacement and distance traveled
Find areas between curves and volumes with cross sections, disks and washers
